title: Marinated Chickpeas

ingredients.name: cooked chickpeas
ingredients.notes: 3 to 4 cups; from about 10 ounces dried chickpeas cooked and drained, or two 15-ounce cans drained

ingredients.name: sherry vinegar or white wine vinegar
kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl and season to taste with salt and pepper. Refrigerate for at least a few hours and up to 1 week; the flavor improves with time.

notes: Dried chickpeas absorb the marinade better than canned. To cook from dry, soak overnight in lightly salted water, drain, then simmer in fresh lightly salted water with a bay leaf and a few peppercorns until tender, about 30 minutes. Drain and dress while warm.
